nodes.text: Connecting Cultures and History with Cathay Cargo

Ancient Egypt Unveiled—Treasures from Egyptian Museums From the colossal statue of Tutankhamun to intricate mummy coffins and countless artefacts spanning over 4,000 years of history, national treasures demand more than just transportation. Cathay Cargo recently supported the safe passage of 250 priceless artefacts weighing more than 30 tonnes from the Supreme Council of Antiquities (“SCA”) of Egypt to the Hong Kong Palace Museum for their next exhibition, “Ancient Egypt Unveiled—Treasures from Egyptian Museums”. From Shanghai to Hong Kong, the shipment was overseen and managed by Cathay Secure under vulnerable cargo codes for the highest handling standards. Under CCTV surveillance and highly trained professionals, operations followed the “light, slow, steady” handling standards from security check, pallet build-up, ramp loading, to warehouse breakdown. “Ancient Egypt Unveiled—Treasures from Egyptian Museums” marks the largest, most comprehensive, and longest-running display of ancient Egyptian treasures in Hong Kong. For the first time, Hong Kong will exhibit museum artefacts and the latest archaeological findings directly loaned from Egypt. SCA, the sole owner and lender of all artefacts, is honoured to share these treasures with the people of Hong Kong and the world, as part of its mission to preserve, protect, and promote Egypt’s cultural heritage through international collaboration. Successful museum partnerships have made us the trusted choice for transporting some of the world’s most valuable and vulnerable cargo, and we’re honoured to help preserve these treasures while connecting cultures worldwide. Learn more: https://bit.ly/4p14a9V #cathaycargo #weknowhow #cathaysecure #aircargo #airfreight #logisticssolutions #HongKongPalaceMuseum
